text:
Four power banks in the search results support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Only two come with a purchase link I can verify for the US.

**Available to buy in the US**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52** (10,000 mAh, 45W USB-C port): It's Qi2.2-certified, with up to 25W wireless on the iPhone 17 series, and it also works with the iPhone 16 series and Pixel 10 Pro XL ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)).
  - Price: $59.99 on Baseus's US store, or $79.99 on Amazon at launch. Code AM52 takes $6 off, for $53.99. Dealectric tested the code in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-25 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-discount-codes)).
  - Buy: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so Baseus pays Dealectric a commission at no cost to you.

- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro** (10,000 mAh): It has Qi2.2 25W wireless, an active-cooling fan, a smart display, a built-in stand, and 45W USB-C in and out. It's Apple-only (iPhone 13 through 17, except the 16e).
  - Price: $109.99. It's a pre-order that ships Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026 ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)).
  - Buy: [Anker MagGo 2 Pro](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910).

**Supported, but I couldn't confirm a current US listing**

- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank**: This was the first power bank certified for Qi2.2 by the Wireless Power Consortium, with 25W wireless charging. UGREEN planned a Q3 2025 launch on its site and Amazon ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). The results gave no price or product page, so search UGREEN's store or Amazon directly.
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank** (10,000 mAh, 13.8 mm thick): ESR calls it the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank and optimized for the iPhone 17 series. The release says "Qi2 25W" rather than "Qi2.2", and it gave no direct product link, only that it's sold on Amazon and ESR's site ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)).

The CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro also supports Qi2.2 25W, but it was released in Japan (¥8,980), so I left it out ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)).

For the best value on a confirmed Qi2.2 25W model, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 is the cheapest. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling.
